prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-end fashion portrait of an adult woman seated in a leather armchair in a dark luxury lounge. She wears a floor-length red satin one-shoulder gown with a structured bodice, has long black side-swept waves, classic natural glam makeup, and a calm elegant smile. Her torso angles gently toward camera, one hand rests on the chair arm and the other near her lap. Surround her with dark wood, black glass, warm amber practical lamps, ornate gold ceiling artwork, and soft distant bokeh. Use a large diffused camera-left key, subtle warm rim light, controlled shadow detail, specular satin highlights, 50mm cinematic realism, natural skin texture, deep blacks, warm ambers, rich crimson, and fine film grain.
